Edit_Order_Allocation_Request.label: Edit Order Allocation Request
text: Set up shipping sites and allocate quantities For each site you want to ship materials to, add a new site column to the table below. Then select the gear icon to choose shipping contact and address and provide special instructions such as, desired delivery range. Assign quantities to allocate to each site column. Review your selections, then click Confirm. Or select Save to return later to finish. Please note: Each request is limited to 10 sites. For district warehouse deliveries , create separate site columns for each school to which a shipment should go. To annually replenish consumables , like notebooks or activity books, allocate only the needed quantities for the intended school year. The first editable column shows recommended quantities. Non-consumables , such as teacher materials, should be allocated, in total, the first year of implementation.

This order is a multiyear order. You are not required to take all of your order quantities unless it is the final year of the order. We have provided a current year suggested quantity in your first allocation column below.
